prompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope is themed around a princess aesthetic, feeling regal, handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers, pearlescent and metallic accents in red, royal blue, golden yellow, forest green and off-white. Elegant folds, precise geometry, embossed royal motifs, delicate filigree, ornamental borders, and a finely detailed wax seal or ribbon closure evoke a noble, fairytale-inspired invitation. The envelope is placed within a rich, story-driven environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a narrative scene — such as a magical castle courtyard, an enchanted royal ballroom entrance, or a fairytale garden at dusk — softly blurred but visually recognizable. Architecture, arches, towers, floral arrangements or decorative scenery elements create depth and context while keeping the envelope as the clear hero. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including roses, petals, crowns, sparkles, butterflies, glowing dust and soft magical particles, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements feel natural, floating gently, enhancing motion and wonder without overpowering the composition. Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and volumetric light rays streaming from above or behind. Subtle mist, atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, royal and premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, inspired by luxury princess invitations and editorial fantasy photography — rich red, royal blue, warm golden yellow, elegant gold, deep forest green and soft off-white — with smooth gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast. Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium princess invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium princess invitations, celebrations and storytelling visuals.

folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a **blank decorative sheet of paper** as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame, with strong central presence and elegant proportions. The sheet is pristine, luxurious and refined, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers, gentle off-white tone, clean edges, and a premium handcrafted feel. The paper remains completely blank, intentionally reserved for text or illustration, while ornate embellishments frame it beautifully without covering the center. Around the sheet, elaborate royal decorations create a princess-themed atmosphere: delicate golden filigree, jeweled flourishes, elegant ribbons, floral ornaments, crown-like motifs, sparkling accents, and refined ornamental borders. The composition allows visible space for the floor, background and side elements, so the scene feels immersive and dimensional rather than flat.

The environment is a regal princess-inspired setting, rich in storytelling and visual depth — such as an enchanted palace hall, a royal ballroom, or a magical castle interior with elegant architecture. The background is softly blurred but still recognizable, with graceful columns, chandeliers, draped fabrics, polished stone floor, and subtle decorative details creating a noble atmosphere. Side elements frame the sheet naturally, including royal flowers, petals, ornamental vines, gemstones, butterflies, glowing particles, and tasteful magical sparkles. These elements are arranged organically around the paper, enhancing the sense of fantasy and elegance without overpowering the blank center.

Lighting is cinematic and luxurious, with soft key light illuminating the paper surface, delicate rim light outlining the edges, and subtle volumetric rays enhancing the royal mood. Atmospheric haze, floating dust and luminous particles catch the light, creating a dreamy princess aesthetic. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional, grounding the sheet within the environment and revealing the floor beneath it. The color palette is rich and harmonious, inspired by royal fantasy and luxury stationery: **red, royal blue, yellow, gold, forest green, and off-white**, balanced with luminous highlights and controlled contrast. Gold accents feel regal and radiant, while the reds and blues add majesty, the yellow brings warmth, and the forest green adds depth and sophistication.

Composition: foreground-dominant blank sheet, sharply in focus, occupying nearly the full frame, with visible floor at the bottom, softly defocused background, decorative side framing, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro and editorial photography look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and ornamental details, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, royal, magical, premium princess stationery aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for princess-themed invitations, royal announcements and fantasy storytelling visuals.

aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
